<p>A private investigator is hired to find the killer of a high-ranking executive, but the objective isn’t for justice — it’s for an escape. Embroiled in a network of Militech agents, he’ll need to find the killer before they do, but what truth are they trying to silence? And with ties to one of Night City’s most dangerous gangs, the death of one corpo may be just the beginning.</p>
